lead.title: Tissium wins CE mark for ECLIPSIUM, its non-penetrating mesh fixation for ventral hernia
lead.deck: The Paris and Cambridge, MA company secures CE marking to fix a composite mesh without tacks or sutures in minimally invasive ventral hernia repair, based on the European ALPHA study (Belgium, Spain). It is the second product on its light-activated polymer platform after COAPTIUM CONNECT (FDA De Novo, nerve repair); European launch expected in 2027.

milestone.title: First patient treated in IBA's C-FLASH-01 ConformalFLASH proton therapy trial
milestone.summary: IBA (Belgium) announces the first patient treated in C-FLASH-01 (NCT07644585), the first human feasibility study of conformal ultra-high-dose-rate proton therapy, run with Penn Medicine under an FDA IDE in 10 head-and-neck re-irradiation patients.
milestone.why: FLASH aims to spare healthy tissue by delivering the dose in a fraction of a second: this is the first human test of the approach on a commercial proton system, with feasibility and acute toxicity as primary endpoints.

brefsEurope.title: FDA accepts for review the 510(k) for the SonoClear System, an ultrasound coupling fluid for brain tumor resection
brefsEurope.summary: A spin-out of Trondheim's ultrasound centre, SonoClear AS (Breakthrough Device) has its 510(k) accepted for substantive review after a 44-patient pivotal study met its safety endpoints. Shareholders: SINTEF Venture IV, Sarsia, CoFounder, Sparebank 1 SMN.

brefsEurope.title: ONWARD Medical appoints Fouad Azzam (partner at EQT Life Sciences) as non-executive director
brefsEurope.summary: The spinal cord stimulation company adds to its board a representative of one of its investors (EQT, part of the ~€40.6M April 2026 placement) as it scales commercially.

word.definition: A technique that delivers the radiation dose in under a second (>40 Gy/s) instead of minutes, aiming to destroy the tumor while sparing more healthy tissue.

parts.label: Accelerator
parts.role: the very-high-dose-rate beam source (protons or electrons)

how.t: An adapted accelerator produces a beam far more intense than standard clinical delivery.
The dose is delivered in a few tenths of a second rather than minutes.
In preclinical models healthy tissue appears better preserved at comparable tumor efficacy; human confirmation is pending.

word.why: If tissue sparing is confirmed it is a clinical-efficacy and pricing argument for radiotherapy centers. First human trials (IBA/Penn, today) and French public programs (FLASHDEEP, FRATHEA) make it a theme to watch.

startups.name: THERYQ
startups.use: Subsidiary of the Alcen group (from PMB-Alcen); develops FLASHDEEP, a very-high-energy electron system for deep tumors with Gustave Roussy and CERN, backed by Bpifrance (France 2030, €38M)

startups.name: IBA
startups.use: Listed Belgian group (not a startup); sponsor of C-FLASH-01, the first human study of ConformalFLASH proton therapy, with Penn Medicine
